issue.body: ### Feature Description This is somewhere between a bug and a feature, but currently attachment added, deleted is not included in the edit log in comments. In fact, the history log just gets an entry with no diff. ### Screenshots Related to: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/23290 and https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/24195

body: Until proper editing of attachments on reviews is implemented, would adding `ignore_attachments: true` to the request fix the issue?

Good catch, the "attachment removal" code was already quite buggy before (this bug is not the first time appearing....)

I guess we need to rewrite it.

I am working on it.

issue.body:
Close #24195

Some of the changes are taken from my another fix https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/20147/commits/f07b0de997125c9b79cc5af27966a7cdd1803a4d in #20147 (although that PR was discarded ....)


The bug is:

1. The old code doesn't handle `removedfile` event correctly
2. The old code doesn't provide attachments for type=CommentTypeReview


This PR doesn't intend to refactor the "upload" code to a perfect state (to avoid making the review difficult), so some legacy styles are kept.
